result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it narrows Customer’s indemnity to Customer-provided materials and breach of law, and adds Vendor indemnities for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access or disclosure, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct. It also includes standard notice, defence control, settlement, participation, and cooperation procedures. The IP exclusions and remedies are consistent with the fallback and remain confined to the indemnity framework. The principal drafting defect is the reference to “Section 20.2(a),” because the added Vendor indemnity is not numbered as Section 20.2; the new paragraphs should be numbered and cross-references conformed.
